dog.description_text:
Meet Simba

Well, hello handsome! With his stunning reddish-brown and cream coat, beautiful markings, striking eyes, and gorgeous fluffy face, Simba is quite the showstopper! This handsome Husky has a look that’s impossible to forget and a personality we hope will capture your heart.

As a Husky, Simba is looking for a family familiar with the breed and everything that makes these dogs so special. Huskies are intelligent, energetic, independent, and full of personality. He’ll need a home that understands his needs, appreciates his adventurous spirit, and is ready to provide the exercise, engagement, structure, and guidance this breed thrives on.

If you’ve always had a soft spot for Huskies, Simba might just be the handsome companion you’ve been waiting for. He’s ready to find his people and begin his next adventure. Could that adventure be with you?

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. Reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Simba and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in adopting or fostering? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
